translations.web: He who swears by the temple, swears by it, and by him who has been living in it.
translations.bsb: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
translations.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
translations.asv: And he that sweareth by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
